text: In 2016, property owners/occupants of houses on Liscombe Road where polled to gauge support for the installation of speed humps. At that time, 22 respondents voted against the installation of speed humps and 19 in support. There has been a renewed interest in the installation of speed humps on this street. As the moratorium to conduct a new poll for speed humps on Liscombe Road expired in October 2018, the proposal for speed humps can be reconsidered.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the Director, Transportation Services, to request the City Clerk to poll eligible householders in English or any other language specified by Community Council, on Liscombe Road, between Rustic Road and Maple Leaf Drive, to determine if property owners/occupants support the installation of speed humps, according to the City of Toronto Traffic Calming Policy. 2. Subject to favourable results of the poll: a. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Liscombe Road, between Rustic Road and Maple Leaf Drive. b. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Liscombe Road for traffic calming enhancement, generally as shown on a map to be provided by Transportation Services and circulated to residents during the polling process.
